name: markdown-viewer-desktop
description: A lightweight Neutralinojs desktop build for Markdown Viewer with live preview, diagrams, math, and PDF/HTML/PNG exports.

scripts.build: npx -y @neutralinojs/neu@11.7.0 build --release --clean && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/markdown-viewer-release.zip')) fs.unlinkSync('dist/markdown-viewer-release.zip');"
